placement_tasks.prompt_en: Put the tasty sandwich onto the serving counter.
placement_tasks.prompt_zh: 点一份三明治（sandwich）端到取餐窗口前

placement_tasks.prompt_en: Set your warm milk neatly on the dining table.
placement_tasks.prompt_zh: 把牛奶（milk）稳稳摆在餐桌中央

placement_tasks.prompt_en: Return your clean empty plate to the tray!
placement_tasks.prompt_zh: 把光盘后的空餐盘（plate）放进回收托盘中央

playground.bench_title_zh: 青草操场 · 器材架与课间阳光运动

macro_items.sentence_en: Play safely, take turns, and cheer for your friends on the playground!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 在操场入口看看友善运动约定：注意安全、轮流玩耍、为伙伴加油！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Wear a sunny cap when playing outdoors!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 大晴天户外活动戴上小黄帽防晒！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Remember to bring your water bottle outside.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 来操场跑步记得带上自己的小水壶。

layer2_items.sentence_en: Ten minutes of sunny break — let's go play!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 阳光大课间十分钟，快去尽情运动吧！

placement_task.prompt_en: Set your water bottle neatly by the game board.
placement_task.prompt_zh: 跑步前先把水壶（water）放好在约定牌下

macro_items.sentence_en: Basketballs, footballs, and jump ropes wait on the sports rack!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 走近左侧体育器材架，挑一样你最拿手的球类或跳绳和彼得一起玩！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Can you bounce and shoot the orange basketball?
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 你会拍着橙色篮球投篮吗？

layer2_items.sentence_en: Peter kicks the black-and-white football!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 彼得一脚传出黑白相间的足球！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Anne jumps rope twenty times without stopping!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 安妮能一口气连跳二十下跳绳！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Table tennis balls are light, round, and fast!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 橙色乒乓球又轻又圆、弹跳飞快！

placement_task.prompt_en: Return the orange basketball to the rack.
placement_task.prompt_zh: 运动完把篮球（basketball）放回器材架

macro_items.sentence_en: Run, fly kites, and play games together on the soft green grass!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 在宽阔柔软的中央绿草坪游戏圈里，和同学们放风筝、做合作游戏！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Look! Our kite is flying high in the blue sky!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 快看！我们的彩虹风筝飞上蓝天啦！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Hold onto your hat in the playful breeze!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 微风吹过草坪，扶好你的小草帽！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Little white daisies grow around the field edge.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 草坪边点缀着朵朵白色小雏菊。

placement_task.prompt_en: Launch the colourful kite over the game circle!
placement_task.prompt_zh: 在中央游戏圈放飞彩虹风筝（kite）

macro_items.sentence_en: Hop on one foot and count loudly in English from one to six!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 在右侧彩虹数字跳格线上，边单脚跳边用英语清脆数出数字吧！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Draw bright hopscotch squares with chalk!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 用彩色粉笔画出漂亮的跳房子方格！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Light running shoes help you jump higher!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 穿上轻便运动鞋跳得又稳又高！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Hop all the way to the golden star square!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 一路单脚跳到终点金色星星格！

placement_task.prompt_en: Toss the lucky star marker onto the top hopscotch square!
placement_task.prompt_zh: 把星星沙包（star）投进跳格子终点格

macro_items.sentence_en: Wipe your sweat, drink cool water, and look at our sports photo wall!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 运动出汗后擦擦汗、喝口水，看看同学们的课间运动抓拍墙！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Wipe your forehead with a clean sweat towel.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 用干净的小汗巾擦擦额头的汗珠。

layer2_items.sentence_en: Drink small sips of water after running fast.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 快跑之后小口慢喝温水最解渴。

layer2_items.sentence_en: Everyone is laughing in our sports day photo!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 运动会抓拍照片里每个人都笑得超灿烂！

placement_task.prompt_en: Fold your clean sweat towel on the ledge.
placement_task.prompt_zh: 把运动汗巾（towel）叠放在休息栏边

football_field.bench_title_zh: 绿茵足球场 · 球门中圈与球队运动装备

macro_items.sentence_en: Gear up at the team rack with Mr Wang and Tim before kick-off!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 比赛开始前，在球队装备架旁跟着王老师和蒂姆穿好队服与球鞋吧！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Put on your number ten red team shirt!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 穿上帅气的十号红色运动球衣！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Tie your football shoes tightly before running.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 上场奔跑前一定要把球鞋鞋带系紧。

layer2_items.sentence_en: Line up all team bags neatly on the rack.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 把队员们的运动包整齐摆放在装备架上。

layer2_items.sentence_en: Keep your water bottle ready for half-time!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 把补水瓶放好，中场休息及时喝水！

placement_task.prompt_en: Line up the spare football shoes in front of the rack.
placement_task.prompt_zh: 把球鞋（shoes）整整齐齐摆在装备架前

macro_items.sentence_en: Tweet! Mr Wang blows the whistle at the white centre circle!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 嘟——！王老师在绿茵场中央白圈吹响哨声，友谊赛正式开球！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Place the football right on the centre spot!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 把黑白足球稳稳摆在开球中圈点上！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Listen to the coach's whistle and play fair!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 听清教练哨音，遵守规则友谊第一！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Mr Wang cheers for both teams in his yellow cap.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 戴着黄运动帽的王老师为双方队员鼓掌加油。

placement_task.prompt_en: Set the football right in the centre circle!
placement_task.prompt_zh: 把比赛足球（football）摆到中圈开球点正中

macro_items.sentence_en: Aim carefully and kick the ball into the white goal — Goal!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 瞄准白色球门果断起脚射门——好球得分！

layer2_items.sentence_en: What a great shot into the corner of the goal!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 多精彩的一脚射门，足球稳稳飞入球网！

layer2_items.sentence_en: The goalkeeper catches the ball with thick gloves!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 守门员戴着厚实的手套稳稳抱住来球！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Teamwork wins a bright golden star!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 默契传球配合赢得了闪亮金星！

placement_task.prompt_en: Kick the football cleanly into the goal!
placement_task.prompt_zh: 点选足球（football），射入白色球门！

macro_items.sentence_en: Dribble left and right around the orange cones and pass to Tim!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 在传球练习区左脚右脚灵巧带球绕过橙色标志桶，再传给队友蒂姆！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Pass the football gently with the inside of your foot.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 用脚内侧稳稳把球传给跑位的同伴。

layer2_items.sentence_en: Pull up your white sports socks to protect your legs.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 拉好白色长筒运动球袜保护小腿。

layer2_items.sentence_en: Take a short breather after five dribbling rounds.
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 完成五组绕桩传球后擦擦汗歇一歇。

placement_task.prompt_en: Tap the football smoothly beside the training cone!
placement_task.prompt_zh: 把训练足球（football）精准停在橙色标志桶旁

macro_items.sentence_en: Check the big scoreboard — 2 to 2, everyone played their best!
macro_items.sentence_zh: 看看看台旁的大计分牌——双方拼尽全力、握手击掌祝贺！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Flip the number card to show two points!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 翻动数字计分牌，记下精彩一分！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Win or lose, we are all good friends!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 无论输赢，我们都是互相鼓励的好伙伴！

layer2_items.sentence_en: Say cheese for our sunny football team photo!
layer2_items.sentence_zh: 茄子！拍一张阳光足球队全家福！

placement_task.prompt_en: Update the score card on the scoreboard!
placement_task.prompt_zh: 把比分牌（card）挂上比赛计分板
